userMessage: Set up an evaluation on my existing workflow that scores the AI Agent's answers against a test dataset. Use a config-based evaluation — do not add any evaluation nodes to the canvas.

options.systemMessage: You answer customer support questions about our product.

rationale: Regression coverage for runtime skill loading of the config-evals skill. Config-based evaluation work must load the config-evals skill, and must never wire on-canvas evaluation nodes via the node-based evals tool or the eval-setup sub-agent. The seed gives the stub instance the existing AI Agent workflow that the prompt refers to, so the Assistant does not stop to ask which workflow to use.
